differences: Idempotence concerns duplication of one state; commutativity concerns ordering two states.
Their Law/Theorem record roles also differ.

mapping.assumptions: Pure state algebra only; neither statement supplies network delivery or liveness guarantees.
mapping.carriers: The same state carrier S, explicitly a join semilattice with bottom.
mapping.equality: Identity equality on the same state carrier.
mapping.operations: The same binary merge, observed on repeated inputs versus exchanged inputs.

result.rationale: Repeated-state absorption and argument-order independence are different laws. Both concern merge, but one constrains merge(s,s) and the other compares merge(s,t) with merge(t,s); retain both.
